text:
Alice T: Heads-up: p95 on /chat-stream shows weird dips across regions today. US-west p95=240ms, eu-west p95=1.8s, but sample counts for eu-west are tiny (n=8).
Ravi P: yup saw the same. dashboard shows percentiles without sample count badges in the routes pane, that's dangerous.
Mei L: do we have a min-sample threshold in rollups? I thought we used 30 by default.
Alice T: the global rollup seems to ignore threshold when you expand to endpoint-level. it shows blended percentiles across regions with no provenance.
Ravi P: nasty: users will see p95 jump and start paging SRE. We should show a confidence indicator or hide percentiles under low-sample.
ConsoleBot: query: SELECT count(), p95(latency_ms) BY region,endpoint FROM latency_vectors WHERE ts BETWEEN 1769811200 AND 1769812000
Mei L: results: endpoint=/chat-stream region=eu-west count=8 p95=1800ms; region=us-west count=420 p95=240ms; region=ap-sg count=5 p95=2200ms
Alice T: so multi-region rollup is aggregating those into a global p95=300ms which masks high tails in small regions. Also our legend doesn't indicate sample origin.
Ravi P: two actions: 1) short-term: show sample_count badge next to each percentile in the UI and gray out values where count < 30 2) long-term: change rollup alg to compute weighted percentiles or present region-level breakdown by default when variance between regions > 3x
Mei L: +1. also add an option to toggle 'require_min_samples' in the console query bar for power users.
Alice T: can someone open a tiny console PR for the badge and gray-out? low risk and helps immediately.
Ravi P: I'll put together a quick patch to add a small counter chip. keeping it hidden behind a feature flag maybe.
Mei L: I'll file infra ticket to add provenance tags to metrics (origin_region, sample_source:proxy|direct) so rollups can avoid mixing proxies with direct client timings.
ConsoleBot: NOTE: if you filter rollups by sample_source the p95 shifts significantly for several endpoints.
Ravi P: another gotcha: our percentile calc uses different interpolation between histogram-backed rollups vs raw sample rollups. that can produce off-by-values when counts low. we should standardize on nearest-rank for small-sample buckets.
Alice T: good catch. can the infra ticket include a recommendation for deterministic algo for counts < 100? Mei?
Mei L: sure, I'll add it: nearest-rank for n<100, interpolation otherwise, plus explicit doc in metrics guide.
Ravi P: timeline: I'll open the console PR (feature flag) in the next hour. Mei will file infra ticket with alg + provenance. Alice will notify customers impacted by eu-west oddity.
Alice T: also add an alert template to avoid paging on low-sample percentile spikes. We keep paging noise down.
Mei L: will do. I'll also add tests to the rollup pipeline to assert sample_count surfaces in the API.
ConsoleBot: feature-flagged console patch deployed to staging.
Alice T: thanks all. once the badge is live we can triage whether the global p95 is actually meaningful or misleading.
Ravi P: quick note for UX: show a tooltip "percentile computed from N samples; values may be unstable for N<30". small but helpful.
Mei L: agreed. closing this thread after PR lands.
InfraBot: ticket created IR-4124: "metric-provenance-and-percentile-algorithm-consistency" assigned to @Mei L"
